post.summary: Authenticates a user and creates an authentication session.

requestBody.description: A token to monitor for cancellation requests.

200.description: The user was successfully authenticated and an authentication cookie was created.

400.description: The supplied request was invalid.

post.summary: Refreshes the authentication tokens using the supplied refresh token.
post.description:
The CSRF token must be supplied in the `X-CSRF-Token` request header.
The value of this header must match the `csrf_token` cookie sent with the request.
Requests with a missing or invalid CSRF token are rejected with an unauthorized response.

200.description: The refresh token was successfully exchanged for new authentication credentials.

400.description: The refresh token request was invalid or could not be processed.

401.description: The CSRF token was missing or invalid, or the supplied authentication credentials were unauthorized.

post.summary: Ends the current authentication session and clears authentication cookies.

200.description: The user was signed out and authentication cookies were cleared.

401.description: The CSRF token was missing or invalid.

post.summary: Completes a multi-factor authentication challenge for an existing authentication session.

requestBody.description: A token to monitor for cancellation requests.

200.description:
The multi-factor authentication challenge was successfully completed and an
authentication cookie was created.

400.description: The supplied request was invalid.

401.description: The authentication session or verification code was invalid.

post.summary: Sets up SMS multi-factor authentication for a user.

200.description: OK

400.description: Bad Request

404.description: Not Found

post.summary: Verifies the user's SMS multi-factor authentication setup by validating the provided authentication code.

200.description: OK

400.description: Bad Request

404.description: Not Found

get.summary: Validates whether a user setup token is valid and can be used to complete the user setup process.

parameters.name: setupToken
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the setup token to validate.

200.description: The setup token is valid and can be used.

400.description: The setupToken query parameter was missing or was not a valid GUID.

404.description: The specified setup token does not exist.

409.description: The setup token has already been consumed.

post.summary:
Reissues an expired setup token and emails a new setup link to the user's
registered email address.

requestBody.description: A token to monitor for cancellation requests.

200.description:
A new setup link was generated and emailed to the user's registered email address.
The response body contains the correlation id for the new setup token.

400.description:
The request body was missing or malformed, or did not supply exactly one of
a setup token or a correlation id.

403.description: The setup token has already been resent the maximum number of times.

404.description: The specified setup token or correlation id does not exist.

409.description: The setup token has already been consumed.

post.summary: Completes the setup process for a user account using a valid setup token.

requestBody.description: A token that can be used to cancel the asynchronous operation.

200.description: OK

400.description: Bad Request

404.description: Not Found

post.summary:
Verifies the user's multi-factor authentication setup by validating the
provided authentication code.

requestBody.description: The token used to cancel the operation.

200.description: The multi-factor authentication setup was successfully verified.

400.description:
The request contained invalid data or the multi-factor authentication
verification could not be completed.

404.description: The multi-factor authentication onboarding record was not found.

post.summary: Initiates the forgotten password procedure for a user.
post.description:
Starts the password recovery flow for the account identified in the command.
The number of attempts is limited; once the permitted limit has been exceeded,
further requests are rejected.

requestBody.description: A token that can be used to cancel the operation.

200.description: The forgotten password procedure was initiated successfully.

429.description: The number of permitted attempts has been exceeded.

post.summary: Confirms a password reset by validating the confirmation code and setting a new password.

requestBody.description: A token to cancel the operation.

200.description: The password was changed successfully.

400.description:
The request failed validation. This occurs when the confirmation code is incorrect or has expired,
or when the new password does not meet the password requirements.
The response body is a ValidationProblemDetails identifying the invalid field.

429.description:
Too many requests were made, or too many failed attempts have occurred.
The response body is a ProblemDetails. The client should wait before retrying.
